comparison.objective: Lay cutting templates along one edge of streaky glass and align them with the streak direction.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual orientation, planar layout, edge alignment, and careful placement.
comparison.success_condition: Templates follow the streaks and specified edge; spacing, tolerance, and glass-damage rules are absent.
comparison.reason: Planar template layout is different from manipulating a retained rotary adjuster and demonstrating safe dynamic stops.
